visual.name: bfusionPortfolioDrift
visual.description: Timelapse of status-report history: every project is a bubble (schedule slip vs cost variance) that moves week by week or month by month. Press play to see how the portfolio drifted and which projects drove it.

dataRoles.name: project
dataRoles.description: Project name. One bubble per value.

dataRoles.name: program
dataRoles.description: Optional. Shown in tooltips and list hover text.

dataRoles.name: health
dataRoles.description: Optional. Overall health text such as (1) On Track. Without it, colour comes from the slip and cost thresholds.

dataRoles.name: status
dataRoles.description: Optional. Plan state; Closed or Completed makes the project leave the chart.

dataRoles.name: estimatedEnd
dataRoles.description: Latest estimated end date. With Baseline end it gives schedule slip.

dataRoles.name: budget
dataRoles.description: With Forecast it gives cost variance %. Also the default bubble size.

dataRoles.name: xValue
dataRoles.description: Optional. Replaces schedule slip on the horizontal axis.

dataRoles.name: yValue
dataRoles.description: Optional. Replaces cost variance on the vertical axis.

dataRoles.name: size
dataRoles.description: Optional. Bubble size; Budget when empty.

dataRoles.name: licenseToken
dataRoles.description: Bind to the single-cell BFusionLicense[Key] column in your model

mode.description: Surface theme for the visual chrome. Auto follows the report theme's background.

background.description: Custom mode only. Plot and root background.

surface.description: Custom mode only. Header, toolbar, panels, tiles and tooltips.

textColor.description: Custom mode only. Primary text colour.

mutedColor.description: Custom mode only. Labels, captions and axis text.

ruleColor.description: Custom mode only. Separators, tile borders and axis lines.

licenseKey.description: Paste your BFusion license key here. Contact info@bfusion.eu for a license.
